blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Counterfactual image generation answers questions about how a subject would have looked under retrospective, hypothetical scenarios.
Recent methods have improved perceptual quality, identity preservation and faithfulness to an underlying causal model, but their adoption in healthcare is limited by scarce annotated data, distribution shift between datasets, and mismatches between pretrained generative models and those required for counterfactual inference.
We propose specialisation , a data and parameter-efficient framework for adapting pretrained, non-causal generative models into causal mechanisms under distribution shift.
Based on this framework, we train a radiology counterfactual image generation model, called RadCF, using latent flow matching.
We validate our approach on three chest X-ray datasets spanning different dataset shifts, data volumes, and counterfactual questions, associated with challenging, highly-localised interventions.
Our results show that RadCF and specialisation improve counterfactual soundness over existing methods while being data and parameter efficient, and that the resulting counterfactuals can detect and mitigate shortcut learning in a downstream medical classifier.
Code is available at https://github.com/GSK-AI/RadCF/ .

最近的方法提高了知觉质量、身份保存和对基本因果模型的忠诚度,但是由于缺少附加说明的数据、数据集之间的分布转移以及预先训练的基因模型与反事实推断所需的模型之间的不匹配,这些方法在保健方面的采用受到限制。
我们提议专门化、数据和参数效率高的框架,以便将经过预先训练的非因果基因模型纳入分配变化中的因果机制。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Advances in generative modelling have improved faithfulness and control in medical image synthesis, particularly for chest X-rays [ 5 , 44 , 72 , 47 , 68 ] .
However, these models often struggle with fine-grained, causal edits, as they implicitly learn broad statistical associations between dense conditioning signals and images.
In the healthcare domain, models require an understanding of how genetic, environmental, or lifestyle factors interact to generate observations [ 61 , 3 , 46 ] .
This is particularly important when reasoning about counterfactual scenarios in patients, e.g., “What would this scan look like in different imaging conditions?” or “How would a disease have progressed in this individual under alternative treatments?” .
Answering such questions requires generative models that can perform isolated edits while preserving patient-specific anatomy.
blocks.zh:
基因建模方面的进展提高了医学图像合成的可靠性和控制性,特别是胸部X射线[5、44、72、47、68]。
然而,这些模型往往与精细的,因果性的编辑相冲突,因为它们含蓄地学习了密集的调制信号和图像之间的广泛统计关联.
在保健领域,模型要求了解遗传、环境或生活方式因素如何相互作用以产生观测结果[61、3、46]。
当对病人的反事实情景进行推理时,这一点尤其重要,例如“这种扫描在不同成像条件下会是什么样子?” 或“这种疾病在替代治疗下会如何发展?” 。 。 。
回答这类问题需要基因模型,可以进行孤立的编辑,同时保留患者特有的解剖学.

blocks.en:
Pearl [41] formalises counterfactual reasoning using structural causal models (SCMs), in which variables are generated by a set of functional assignments, or mechanisms , forming a directed acyclic graph.
Counterfactual inference is then performed via a simple three-step procedure: abduction-action-prediction . Pawlowski et al. [40] implement SCMs with deep generative models to generate counterfactual images, and, in the absence of ground-truth counterfactuals, Monteiro et al. [35] evaluate counterfactual soundness using metrics grounded in the axiomatic properties of mechanisms [ 15 , 18 ] .
Building on this, hierarchical VAEs [ 69 , 9 , HVAEs, ] , diffusion models [ 63 , 50 , 58 ] , and optimal-transport flow matching [ 30 , 49 , 66 ] have been used to parameterise mechanisms for generating high-fidelity counterfactuals in mammography, 2D and 3D brain MRIs, subcortical meshes and chest X-rays [ 13 , 56 , 54 , 53 , 74 , 43 ] .
However, deploying these models in clinical settings is limited by access to large, annotated datasets [ 73 , 22 ] .
As such, bespoke training is impractical, motivating methods that adapt pretrained models for counterfactual inference in low-data regimes.
blocks.zh:
Pearl [41] 使用结构因果模型(SCM)形式化反事实推理,其中变量由一组函数任务生成,或机制生成,形成一个定向循环图.
然后通过简单的三步程序进行反事实推断:绑架-行动-预测。 Pawlowski等人著. [40] 使用深层基因模型实施SCM,以生成反事实图像,在没有地面真实反事实的情况下,Monteiro等人[35] 利用基于机制定理特性的衡量标准评价反事实健全性[15、18]。
在此基础上,分级的VAEs[69,9,HVAEs,],扩散模型[63,50,58],以及最优化的运输流量匹配[30,49,66],用于参数化在乳房X光学中生成高真假逆射的机制,2D和3D脑核磁共振,亚性膜和胸X光[13,56,54,53,74,43].
然而,在临床环境中部署这些模型受到限制,因为可以获得大型附加说明的数据集[73、22]。
因此,口述培训是不切实际的,可以促使在低数据制度中采用预先训练好的模型进行反事实推断。

blocks.en:
A natural alternative is image editing with pretrained text-to-image foundation models.
This is analogous to counterfactual inference [ 78 , 38 , 39 ] and is increasingly applied to medical image editing [ 17 , 44 , 26 , 11 ] .
These methods control images through text prompts, often with spatial annotations such as masks or bounding boxes to localise edits [ 12 , 29 ] .
However, prompt engineering requires significant expertise, and spatial annotations are often unavailable in clinical practice [ 76 , 70 , 31 ] .
Moreover, masking cannot capture global morphological variations required for edits on attributes such as view, age, or anatomy.
While recent work introduces causal structure into foundation models via adapters [ 67 ] , the resulting approach ignores distribution shifts and biases that medical images are often subject to [ 7 , 59 ] .
blocks.zh:
一个自然的替代品是图像编辑,并预训文本到图像基础模型.
这类似于反事实推论[78、38、39],并越来越多地适用于医疗图像编辑[17、44、26、11]。
这些方法通过文本提示来控制图像,经常带有空间说明,如口罩或绑定框来本地化编辑[12,29].
然而,迅速工程需要大量的专门知识,在临床实践中往往没有空间说明[76、70、31]。
此外,遮盖无法捕捉到在视图、年龄或解剖学等属性上编辑所需的全球形态变化。
虽然最近的工作通过适配器将因果结构引入了基础模型[67],但由此产生的方法忽略了医疗图像往往受制于[7,59]的分布变化和偏见.

blocks.en:
We argue that widespread adoption of counterfactual reasoning in the healthcare domain requires adapting foundation models to operate under distribution shift and limited data, as in medical image generation [ 5 ] . In this work, we propose specialisation , a framework for adapting pretrained generators to parameterise causal mechanisms under distribution shift in low-data regimes.
We then train RadCF, our method for counterfactual image generation in radiology, and study three specialisation settings ( Figure 1 ).
Our contributions are as follows: • We propose specialisation , a data and parameter-efficient framework that adapts pretrained, non-causal generative models into counterfactual image mechanisms ( Section 3.1 ). We formulate a mismatch-to-adaptation principle that links structural, acquisition and measurement mismatches to the model components that should be adapted. • We introduce RadCF for counterfactual inference with latent flow matching ( Section 3.2 ), which improves axiomatic soundness over prior work on radiology datasets. • We show that specialisation extends across dataset shifts ( Section 4.1 ) and generative model classes ( Section 4.2 ), and that the resulting counterfactuals can detect and mitigate shortcut learning in a downstream classifier ( Section 4.3 ).

然后,我们培训RadCF,我们在放射学中反事实图像生成方法,并研究三个特殊设置(图1).
• 我们的贡献如下: 我们提议专门化(第3.1节)。 我们制定了不匹配与适应原则,将结构、获取和测量不匹配与应该调整的模型组件联系起来。 · 我们采用RedCF来进行与潜在流比对的反事实推论(第3.2节),这比以前关于放射数据集的工作更符合逻辑。 我们显示,专门化跨越数据集变化(第4.1节)和基因模型类别(第4.2节),由此产生的反事实可以在下游分类器中探测和减缓捷径学习(第4.3节)。

blocks.en:
Relation to prior work ( Appendix B ). We build on three areas:
(1) Deep generative SCMs use VAEs, diffusion models, or flow-based mechanisms for counterfactual image generation [ 13 , 56 , 54 , 53 , 74 , 43 ] , but are typically trained from scratch for each target domain.
This is impractical when large annotated clinical datasets are difficult to obtain [ 73 , 22 ] .
Unlike image-space flows [ 56 ] , we operate in latent space for high-resolution generation.
(2) Generative foundation models provide high-quality edits through prompts, masks, or bounding boxes [ 17 , 44 , 26 , 11 ] , but offer associative rather than interventional control over structured parent variables.
(3) Methods for adding conditioning and efficiently adapting pretrained generators, including ControlNet and LoRA [ 79 , 20 ] , provide the technical tools for specialisation.
Causal-Adapter [ 67 ] adapts a frozen text-to-image backbone for causal inference, but does not study distribution shift.

Counterfactual inference follows a three-step procedure [ 41 ] : abduction infers the exogenous posterior given the factual observations; action replaces the structural assignment of the intervened variable, denoted do ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \operatorname{do}(\cdot) ; and prediction evaluates the modified SCM at the counterfactual parents 𝐩𝐚 ~ k \widetilde{\mathbf{pa}}_{k} , retaining the same abducted exogenous states.
For mechanisms that are bijective in 𝐮 k \mathbf{u}_{k} at fixed 𝐩𝐚 k \mathbf{pa}_{k} , abduction reduces to inversion, 𝐮 k = f k − 1 ​ ( 𝐱 k , 𝐩𝐚 k ) \mathbf{u}_{k}=f_{k}^{-1}(\mathbf{x}_{k},\mathbf{pa}_{k}) .
For non-invertible mechanisms, it instead requires the posterior over exogenous states compatible with the factual observation.

Counterfactuals from correct SCMs satisfy axiomatic properties [ 15 , 18 ] . Monteiro et al. [35] operationalise these as metrics for composition , reversibility , and effectiveness . Together, they indicate a mechanism’s ability to preserve identity in counterfactuals.
Finally, effectiveness measures faithfulness to interventions via pseudo-oracle classifiers p ⁡ ( 𝐩𝐚 | 𝐱 ) p(\mathbf{pa}|\mathbf{x}) to verify that target attributes change and non-target attributes are preserved (e.g., sex, age), scored by accuracy and MAE.

blocks.en: 3 Method: specialisation for counterfactual image mechanisms
blocks.zh: 3个 方法:反事实图像机制的专门化

blocks.en:
In medical settings, imaging datasets are typically small and cannot easily be pooled due to privacy constraints [ 73 , 22 ] .
Since existing counterfactual generative methods are trained from scratch, these data challenges limit their use in the healthcare domain.
Additionally, observed distributions vary due to acquisition shifts in 𝐱 \mathbf{x} arising from differences in scanners and imaging protocols, and measurement bias in 𝐩𝐚 \mathbf{pa} where observed labels act as imperfect proxies for underlying clinical factors [ 7 , 59 ] .
This limits cross-domain generalisability of pretrained models.
blocks.zh:
在医疗环境下,成像数据集通常很小,由于隐私限制,无法轻易集合[73,22].
由于现有的反事实基因方法是从零开始训练的,这些数据挑战限制了它们在保健领域的使用。
此外,观测到的分布也各不相同,因为X\ mathbf{x}的获取变化源于扫描仪和成像协议的差异,在pa\ mathbf{pa}中,观测到的标签是基本临床因素的不完善代词[7,59]。
这限制了预先训练过的模型的跨域通用性.

blocks.en: 3.1 Specialisation
blocks.zh: 3.1 专业

blocks.en:
To address these gaps, we introduce specialisation , a parameter-efficient procedure that adapts a pretrained generative model into a counterfactual image mechanism.
We consider a generator pretrained on p s ​ ( 𝐱 ) p_{s}(\mathbf{x}) or p s ​ ( 𝐱 ∣ 𝐜 s ) p_{s}(\mathbf{x}\mid\mathbf{c}_{s}) , where 𝐜 s \mathbf{c}_{s} denotes the source conditioning variables.
The target data follow p t ​ ( 𝐱 , 𝐩𝐚 ) p_{t}(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{pa}) , where 𝐩𝐚 \mathbf{pa} denotes the image parents specified by the target SCM.
Specialisation reuses the source-pretrained image prior while adapting the generator to the target image domain and parent structure.
Here, we summarise three possible mismatch scenarios following Castro et al. [7] , and the corresponding specialisation strategy.
blocks.zh:
为了弥补这些差距,我们引入了一种具有参数效率的专用程序,将预先训练的基因模型转化为反事实图像机制。
我们认为一个在 p s ( x) p \\\\ s (\ mathbf{ x}) 或 p s ( x\\ c\ s) p\\ s} (\ mathbf{ x\\ mathbf{ c\\ s}) 上预先训练的生成器, 其中 c s\ mathbf{ c} 表示源条件变量 。
目标数据跟随p t (x, pa) p_{t} (\mathbf{x},\mathbf{pa}),其中pa\mathbf{pa}表示目标SCM指定的图像家长.
专门化在使生成器适应目标图像域和母结构的同时,重新使用源前预设的图像.
在此,我们总结了Castro等人之后三种可能的不匹配情况。 [7],以及相应的专业化战略.

blocks.en:
Structural mismatch and structural specialisation ( s-spec ). Structural mismatch occurs when the source conditioning structure does not expose the target parents 𝐩𝐚 \mathbf{pa} .
It includes unconditional generators, models conditioned on source variables 𝐜 s \mathbf{c}_{s} that omit 𝐩𝐚 \mathbf{pa} or cannot be mapped to it, and target tasks that introduce parents absent at pretraining.
Such models may encode image variation associated with 𝐩𝐚 \mathbf{pa} , but they cannot evaluate the same observation-specific mechanism at factual and counterfactual parent values while holding 𝐮 \mathbf{u} fixed.
We therefore propose s-spec , which introduces the target parent inputs and adapts the generator to evaluate the image mechanism at factual and counterfactual parent assignments.
blocks.zh:
结构不匹配与结构特异性(s-spec ). 当源调结构不暴露目标父母 pa\ mathbf{pa}时,结构不匹配发生.
它包括无条件的生成器,以源变量c s\ mathbf{c}_{s}为条件的模型,省略 pa\mathbf{pa}或无法映射到它,以及引入父母在预训时缺席的目标任务.
这类模型可能编码与 pa\ mathbf{pa} 相关的图像变异, 但是在持有 u\ mathbf{u} 固定时, 它们无法在事实和反事实父值上评价相同的观测特定机制 。
因此,我们提出S-spec,引入目标母输入,并调整生成器,以便在事实和反事实母任务时评价图像机制。

blocks.en:
Acquisition mismatch and structural-acquisition specialisation ( sa-spec ). Acquisition mismatch occurs when source and target datasets differ in scanners, imaging protocols, resolution, or image processing, so that the same underlying anatomy is represented differently in the observed images [ 7 ] .
These differences can impair reconstruction of target observations even after the generator has learned to respond to the target parents. sa-spec therefore extends s-spec by adapting the image representation together with the parent-dependent generation.
This allows the specialised mechanism to accommodate target-domain appearance while retaining the parent-dependent image structure.
blocks.zh:
收购不匹配和结构收购专业(sa-spec.). 当源数据与目标数据集在扫描仪,成像协议,分辨率,或图像处理上存在差异时,即发生获取不匹配现象,这样在观测到的图像中,同样的基础解剖学就得到了不同的体现[7].
即使发电机学会了对目标父母作出反应,这些差异也会影响目标观测的重建。 因此,sa-spec通过与亲子依赖的一代一起调整图像表现来扩展s-spec.
这使得专门机制能够容纳目标域外观,同时保留亲子依赖的图像结构.

blocks.en:
Measurement mismatch and measurement specialisation ( m-spec ). Measurement mismatch occurs when the source model conditions on a proxy for 𝐩𝐚 \mathbf{pa} rather than on the target parents themselves.
In text-conditioned medical generators, free text may omit or conflate target variables or encode information outside the target SCM [ 26 , 11 , 7 , 19 , 62 ] .
Prompt-driven editors also express interventions through selected wording and often use spatial annotations to localise changes [ 44 ] . m-spec bypasses the text encoder and maps structured parents to the backbone’s native conditioning interface.
This preserves the source model’s text-conditioned image knowledge while replacing an indirect proxy with an explicit intervention interface.
Causal-Adapter [ 67 ] addresses this same measurement mismatch with a different adapter design; Section 4.2 compares the two on a shared pretrained text-to-image backbone.
blocks.zh:
测量不匹配和测量专门化(m-spec). 当源模型在 pa\ mathbf{ pa} 的代理条件上而不是在目标父母本身上设置条件时,就会发生测量不匹配.
在文本条件的医疗生成器中,免费文本可以省略或拼凑目标变量或编码目标SCM以外的信息[26,11,7,19,62].
即时驱动编辑器也通过选用的措辞来表达干预,并经常使用空间说明来本地化变化[44]. m-spec绕过文本编码器,将结构化的家长映射到骨干本土的调理界面.
这保留了源模型的文本条件图像知识,同时用明确的干涉界面取代间接的代理.
Causal-Adapter [67] 与不同的适配器设计解决了同样的测量不匹配问题;第4.2节将两者在共享的预训文本到图像主干线上进行比较.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en:
We evaluate specialisation as a data and parameter-efficient adaptation strategy ( Section 4.1 ), m-spec as an extension to text-conditioned editors ( Section 4.2 )
and demonstrate the utility of our counterfactuals on a downstream use case to complement the axiomatic evaluations ( Section 4.3 ).

我们评价专门化作为一种数据和具有参数效率的适应战略(第4.1节),m-spec作为文本条件编辑的延伸(第4.2节)
并证明我们的反事实对下游使用案例的效用,以补充逻辑评价(第4.3节)。

blocks.en:
Unless otherwise stated, experiments specialise a CheXpert-pretrained model [ 21 ] to NIH-14 [ 71 ] using sa-spec .
Across all datasets we extract four parent variables from structured metadata: view position v ∈ { AP , PA } v\in\{\text{AP},\text{PA}\} , sex s ∈ { M , F } s\in\{\text{M},\text{F}\} , age a ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] a\in[0,1] and effusion status e ∈ { 0 , 1 } e\in\{0,1\} .
BRAX [ 55 ] additionally provides a device label d ∈ { 0 , 1 } d\in\{0,1\} , and presents distinct acquisition and population shifts.
See Appendix C for experiment details.

For demographic variables such as age and sex, do ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \operatorname{do}(\cdot) denotes a counterfactual appearance query: “What would this radiograph look like if the patient were older / of a different sex?” rather than a physical clinical action.
We acknowledge the ethical limitations of such interventions, although they are valuable for estimating counterfactual fairness [ 27 ] .

blocks.en:
RadCF as a sound counterfactual mechanism. We first establish the soundness of latent flow matching against three mechanisms: an HVAE [ 13 ] , a latent-diffusion implementation of the spatial mechanism of Rasal et al. [54] , and the image-space flow of Ribeiro et al. [56] .
Effectiveness and identity preservation (the latter measured by composition and reversibility) often trade off in counterfactual image generation [ 54 , 35 ] . Table 1 shows that RadCF provides the strongest overall balance between them, supporting latent flow matching as a strong foundation for axiomatically sound, high-fidelity counterfactual generation.

Empirically, specialisation improves composition and reversibility in low-data regimes.

When is sa-spec necessary? Table 2 isolates the role of acquisition specialisation by comparing s-spec (flow-only) and sa-spec (flow + VAE) under CheXpert → \rightarrow NIH-14 acquisition shift and in-domain CheXpert → \rightarrow CheXpert adaptation.
Under acquisition shift, sa-spec substantially improves composition and reversibility while preserving effectiveness for most attributes.
In-domain, the same adaptation yields minimal change in composition and reversibility.
Full fine-tuning of the flow alone ( s-spec full ) does not recover the same gains, indicating that the improvement comes from acquisition specialisation rather than from additional trainable parameters. Figure 4 visualises this: under acquisition shift, s-spec produces large pixel residuals around the lungs even on null interventions, indicating systematic decoder distortion of target-domain anatomy. sa-spec largely eliminates these residuals, while in-domain both methods produce comparably small residuals.

For a controlled comparison, Causal-Adapter is implemented on the same RadEdit backbone as m-spec ; results on the authors’ original Stable Diffusion 1.5 backbone are in Appendix L .

The result first demonstrates the benefit of structured specialisation.
Under our taxonomy, both RadEdit m-spec and Causal-Adapter [ 67 ] are instances of m-spec : they both turn text-conditioned models into intervened causal variable conditions in 𝐩𝐚 \mathbf{pa} .
For do ⁡ ( e ) \operatorname{do}(e) , both m-spec instances preserve non-target attributes better than text-only SDXL without requiring a localisation mask, indicating more targeted counterfactual changes.
RadEdit m-spec also improves effectiveness over RadEdit.
This broader intervention interface comes with a trade-off: mask-guided RadEdit retains better composition, reversibility, and realism, as shown in Figure 5 .

blocks.en:
We next isolate the choice of specialisation mechanism.
On the same RadEdit backbone, m-spec achieves better target-control point estimates for all four interventions and consistently lower composition error, reversibility error, and KID than Causal-Adapter.
We hypothesise that this advantage arises from the more direct integration of structured variables into RadEdit’s pretrained conditioning pathway: m-spec replaces text embeddings with metadata embeddings at the native conditioning interface, whereas
Causal-Adapter first aligns causal attributes with textual tokens and injects their interactions through an additional adapter.
This simpler, backbone-aligned parameterisation may make the structured conditions easier to optimise while better preserving the pretrained image distribution.

Causal-Adapter首先将因果属性与文字符号对齐,并通过额外的适配器注入它们的相互作用.
这种更简单,主干连接的参数化可能使结构化的条件更容易优化,同时更好地保留预先训练的图像分布.

blocks.en: 4.3 Practicality and utility
blocks.zh: 4.3 实用性和效用

blocks.en:
While our approach improves on current deep generative SCM methods under data scarcity and domain shift, counterfactual inference requires strong assumptions.
In particular, causal sufficiency is assumed: no unobserved confounders are taken into account, and only observed parents can be controlled for or intervened upon.
This assumption underpins most, if not all, deep-SCM counterfactual image generation [ 40 , 35 , 13 , 54 , 56 ] .
Despite a likely violation in real data, counterfactual images may still be practically useful.
We support this claim with additional analyses of their downstream utility, since the assumption cannot be tested directly from observational data [ 38 ] .

虽然在数据稀缺和域位变化的情况下,我们的方法改进了目前深层遗传性SCM方法,但反事实推论需要强有力的假设。
特别是假定因果充足:没有考虑不引人注目的混血儿,只有被观察的父母才能受到控制或干预。
这个假设是大多数(如果不是全部的话)深SCM反事实图像生成的基础[40,35,13,54,56].
尽管真实数据可能存在侵权情况,但反事实图像仍然实际上有用。
我们用对其下游用途的进一步分析来支持这一说法,因为这一假设不能直接从观测数据中测试[38]。

blocks.en:
Exposing shortcut learning. Counterfactuals reveal whether a diagnostic model relies on biased signals in the data to predict the disease status of a patient, i.e. shortcut reliance [ 16 ] .
When the bias is also present in the test set, standard accuracy metrics cannot detect shortcut learning, which is revealed only on an unbiased test set [ 6 ] that is not always available; intervening on the suspect variable removes that requirement.
Simulating ten levels of spurious view–effusion correlation, the rate at which the effusion prediction changes under do ⁡ ( v ) \operatorname{do}(v) rises from 11 % 11\% at no bias to 47 % 47\% at the highest, monotonically across bias levels (Spearman’s ρ = 0.94 \rho=0.94 , p < 0.05 p<0.05 ), while AUC on real images stays within 0.72 0.72 - 0.84 0.84 across all ten models ( Appendix H ).
Counterfactuals therefore detect shortcut learning that standard accuracy metrics miss in the absence of an unbiased test set.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and limitations
blocks.zh: 5. 讨论和限制

blocks.en:
In this work, we show that pretrained generative models can be specialised into image mechanisms for counterfactual generation.
Our central contribution is to frame counterfactual image generation as an adaptation problem: reusing pretrained image knowledge to learn a target mechanism rather than training from scratch.
This perspective complements adapter-based approaches such as Causal-Adapter [ 67 ] .
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们表明,预先训练的基因模型可以专门用于反事实生成的图像机制.
我们的核心贡献是将反事实图像生成设定为适应问题:重新使用预先训练的图像知识来学习目标机制,而不是从零开始训练。
这种观点补充了Causal-Adapter等基于适配器的方法[67].

blocks.en:
Our study examines adaptation under limited data, distribution shift, and changing intervention requirements, addressing practical challenges in medical imaging.
RadCF implements this framework through latent flow matching, providing competitive counterfactual soundness and image fidelity on chest X-rays.
Specialisation also applies beyond flow-based mechanisms.
In particular, m-spec adapts a text-conditional diffusion model to enable structured interventions, without needing text prompts or auxiliary spatial annotations.
In doing so, we take a step toward using foundation models for counterfactual reasoning, with applications in model auditing and data augmentation.
blocks.zh:
我们的研究根据有限的数据、分布变化和不断变化的干预要求,审查适应情况,解决医疗成像方面的实际挑战。
弧度 CF通过潜在流配对执行这个框架,在胸X射线上提供具有竞争力的反事实声音和图像忠贞性.
专门化也适用于流动机制之外。
特别是,m-spec对文本条件扩散模型进行调整,以便能够进行结构化干预,而不需要文本提示或辅助空间说明。
在这样做的过程中,我们迈出了一步,利用基础模型进行反事实推理,应用模型审计和数据扩充。

blocks.en:
Limitations and future work. While our experiments target measurement bias and acquisition shift, specialised mechanisms may still be affected by manifestation shift, where the same clinical factor induces different image-level appearances across populations.
Evaluating zero-shot transfer under such shifts is an important direction for future work.
To scale to high-resolution counterfactual images, RadCF parameterises the mechanism in latent space.
This differs from the exactly invertible image-space mechanisms studied in flow-based counterfactual identification [ 56 ] .
Our mechanism also follows the causal Markovian assumption.

blocks.en: Appendix B Related work
blocks.zh: 附录B 相关工作

blocks.en:
Counterfactual image generation aims to answer retrospective questions about how an observed instance would have appeared under an alternative intervention, while preserving all non-descendant, instance-specific factors.
This is naturally formalised using structural causal models (SCMs), where counterfactuals are computed through abduction, action, and prediction [ 41 , 46 , 61 ] .
Early deep SCMs parameterised image mechanisms with deep generative models, enabling counterfactual generation in settings where the image is treated as a high-dimensional endogenous variable [ 40 ] .
Since ground-truth counterfactual images are generally unavailable, subsequent work has evaluated learned mechanisms through axiomatic criteria such as composition, reversibility, and effectiveness [ 15 , 18 , 35 ] , with realism later incorporated as an additional fidelity criterion [ 34 ] .
These metrics are now widely used to quantify whether generated counterfactuals preserve identity, obey interventions, and remain on the image manifold.
blocks.zh:
反事实图像生成旨在回答关于所观察实例如何在替代干预下出现的追溯性问题,同时保留所有非后裔、具体实例的因素。
这自然是用结构因果模型(SCM)形式化的,通过绑架、行动和预测来计算反事实[41、46、61]。
早期深的SCMs参数化的图像机制带有深的基因模型,可以在将图像作为高维内生变量处理的环境下实现反事实生成[40].
由于一般没有地面真实反事实图像,随后的工作通过组成、可逆性和有效性等不言而喻的标准评价了学习到的机制[15、18、35],而现实主义后来作为补充忠诚标准[34]。
这些衡量标准现在被广泛用于量化生成的反事实是否保留了身份,服从干预,并保留在图像的多重上.

blocks.en:
Building on these, hierarchical VAEs [ 69 , 9 , HVAEs, ] , diffusion models [ 63 , 50 , 58 ] , and optimal-transport flow matching [ 30 , 49 , 66 ] have been used to parameterise mechanisms for generating high-fidelity counterfactuals in mammography, 2D and 3D brain MRIs, subcortical meshes and chest X-rays [ 13 , 56 , 54 , 53 , 74 , 43 ] .
However, most existing counterfactual image generation methods train mechanisms from scratch on the target domain.
This limits their applicability in clinical settings, where annotated data are scarce, costly to obtain, and difficult to pool across institutions because of privacy and governance constraints [ 73 , 22 ] .
In contrast, our work adapts pretrained generative models into causal mechanisms, reducing the need for large target-domain datasets.
blocks.zh:
在此基础上,使用了分级的VAE[69,9,HVAEs,],扩散模型[63,50,58],以及最佳运输流量匹配[30,49,66]参数化机制,在乳房X光学中生成高真伪反真假,2D和3D脑核磁共振,亚性膜和胸X光[13,56,54,53,74,43].
然而,大多数现有的反事实图像生成方法都从目标域的零开始训练机制.
这限制了它们在临床环境中的适用性,在临床环境中,附加说明的数据稀缺,获取费用高昂,而且由于隐私和治理方面的限制,难以跨机构汇集[73,22].
相比之下,我们的工作将预先训练的基因模型调整为因果机制,减少了对大型目标域数据集的需求.

blocks.en:
General-purpose image editing methods such as DiffEdit and text-guided editing localise changes through masks or textual instructions [ 12 , 29 ] , and analogous approaches have been adopted in medical imaging.
In radiology, recent models have used text, reports, masks, or other conditioning signals to synthesise or modify chest X-rays with improved visual fidelity and controllability [ 5 , 72 , 47 , 68 , 17 , 44 , 26 , 11 ] .
These models provide strong image priors and can perform clinically meaningful edits, but their control is usually associative rather than counterfactual: prompts, masks, or bounding boxes specify desired visual changes without explicitly modelling the causal mechanisms that generated the observation.
However, mask-based methods require spatial annotations that are often unavailable in clinical datasets [ 76 , 70 , 31 ] , and local masks may be insufficient for global interventions involving acquisition view, demographic attributes, or anatomical morphology.
Prompt-based control also introduces ambiguity, since clinically relevant causal variables may be only indirectly represented in free text.
blocks.zh:
通用图像编辑方法,如DiffEdit和文字指导编辑,通过口罩或文字说明[12,29]将修改本地化,医学成像中也采用了类似方法.
在放射学中,近代模型使用文字,报告,口罩,或者其他条件信号来合成或修改胸X射线,提高视觉的忠诚性和可控性[5,72,47,68,17,44,26,11].
这些模型提供了强烈的图像前传,可以进行临床有意义的编辑,但是它们的控制通常是关联性的,而不是反事实的:提示,口罩,或者边框指定想要的视觉变化,而没有明确模拟产生观测的因果机制.
然而,基于面具的方法需要空间说明,在临床数据集中往往没有空间说明[76,70,31],对于涉及获取视图、人口属性或解剖形态的全球干预来说,当地面具可能不够。
即时控制也带来了模糊性,因为临床相关的因果变量可能只是间接地体现在自由文本中.

blocks.en:
Our work differs from medical image editing in that we specialise pretrained image models to parameterise explicit SCM mechanisms.
Rather than asking a model to edit an image through a prompt or mask, we abduct an exogenous code from the observed image and regenerate the image under intervened parent variables.
This connects the flexibility of foundation image models with the formal semantics of counterfactual inference.
blocks.zh:
我们的工作与医疗图像编辑不同,因为我们专门使用预先训练的图像模型来参数化明显的SCM机制。
我们不要求一个模型通过一个即时或遮罩编辑一个图像,而是从所观察到的图像中劫持一个外来代码,并在被干涉的母变量下重新生成图像.
这把基础图像模型的灵活性与反事实推论的正式语义联系起来.

blocks.en:
Medical imaging datasets often differ across hospitals, scanners, protocols, patient populations, and labelling pipelines.
Such acquisition shifts and measurement biases can degrade model performance and lead to unreliable conclusions when models are transferred across datasets [ 7 , 59 ] .
Causal approaches have been proposed as a way to reason about these shifts, since SCMs separate stable mechanisms from changing marginal distributions and provide a language for interventions and counterfactuals [ 61 , 3 , 57 ] .
In medical imaging, causal structure has been used to study confounding, improve robustness, and define clinically meaningful image interventions [ 60 , 75 , 33 ] .
However, most work either assumes that the relevant mechanisms can be learned directly from the target domain, or focuses on associative and interventional robustness rather than full counterfactual image generation.
Our setting is more demanding: the target domain may contain limited labelled data, may differ from the source distribution used for pretraining, and may require interventions on variables that were not explicitly modelled during pretraining.
blocks.zh:
医疗成像数据集往往因医院、扫描仪、协议、病人群体和标签管道而异。
这种获取转移和测量偏差可降低模型性能,并在模型跨数据集传输时导致不可靠的结论[7,59].
已提出各种因果办法,作为解释这些变化的一种方法,因为SCMs将稳定机制与变化的边际分布分开,并为干预和反事实提供了一种语言[61、3、57]。
在医学成像中,因果结构被用于研究混淆,提高强性,并定义临床上有意义的图像干预[60,75,33].
然而,大多数工作要么假设相关机制可以直接从目标领域学习,要么侧重于关联性和干预性强性,而不是完全反事实图像生成.
我们的设定要求更高:目标域可能包含有限的标注数据,可能不同于用于预训的源分布,可能需要对在预训期间没有明确模拟的变量进行干预.

blocks.en:
Parameter-efficient fine-tuning has emerged as a practical way to adapt large pretrained models without updating all weights.
Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) learns low-rank weight updates while keeping the pretrained backbone fixed, reducing trainable parameters and improving fine-tuning efficiency [ 20 ] .
Adapter-based methods have also been used to add new forms of conditioning to pretrained image models [ 79 ] .
In the causal setting, Causal-Adapter [ 67 ] is closest to our measurement-specialisation setting: it adapts a frozen text-to-image diffusion backbone by learning causal mechanisms over semantic attributes and injecting them through adapter and token-level conditioning.
In contrast, our specialisation framework targets radiology counterfactual mechanisms under dataset shift: s-spec adds explicit parent conditioning to pretrained generators, sa-spec additionally adapts the latent representation and generator to acquisition-shifted target domains, and m-spec replaces text conditioning with structured clinical parent variables.
blocks.zh:
参数高效的微调已经作为一种实用的方法出现,在不更新所有重量的情况下,对预先训练过的大型模型进行改造.
低Rank适应(LORA)学习低等级重量更新,同时保持预训骨干固定,降低可训练参数,提高微调效率[20].
基于适配器的方法也被用于为预训图像模型添加新的调制形式[79].
在因果关系中,Causal-Adapter [67] 最接近于我们的测量-专门化设置:它通过学习语义属性的因果机制,通过适配器和符号级的调制来调整一个冻结的文本到图像传播主干.
相比之下,我们的专业框架针对数据集转换下的放射学反事实机制:s-spec在预先训练的发电机中添加了明确的母构件,sa-spec又将潜在表示和生成器适应了收购转移的目标域,m-spec用结构化的临床母构件取代文本构件.

All classifiers implement 𝐱 → a \mathbf{x}\rightarrow a and are trained exclusively on the training split of the corresponding evaluation dataset, ensuring no patient-level overlap with the generative evaluation data.
Training uses the Adam optimiser with an 80/20 train/validation split, checkpointing the epoch with best validation AUC for discrete attributes (view, sex, effusion, device) and lowest validation MAE for continuous attributes (age).
Binary decision thresholds are chosen on the validation set to maximise the sum of sensitivity and specificity, then applied to the test set.
Classifier performance is summarised in Table 5 .

Effusion. Based on Aslani et al. [2] , classifiers are trained separately on PA and AP subsets to remove the well-established systematic view-disease confound in chest radiographs [ 52 ] .
All three datasets use label smoothing ( ε = 0.1 \varepsilon=0.1 ) and ReduceLROnPlateau (factor 0.2, patience 3 epochs).
On NIH14, ablation showed that domain-specific initialisation improves Effusion sensitivity: a DenseNet-121 is initialised from CheXpert-pretrained weights via TorchXRayVision [ 10 ] and fine-tuned at lr = 10 − 5 \,{=}\,10^{-5} for up to 20 epochs to preserve these representations.
On CheXpert, alternative domain-pretrained weights and the DenseNet-121 architecture were evaluated in ablation but offered no improvement, so an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-18 is trained at lr = 10 − 4 \,{=}\,10^{-4} for up to 15 epochs.
NIH14 and CheXpert classifiers are benchmarked against published Effusion classifiers in Table 5 , supporting their use as sufficiently performant pseudo-oracles; no published benchmark exists for BRAX.

blocks.en: D.2 Evaluator sensitivity
blocks.zh: D.2 评价者的敏感性

blocks.en:
Effectiveness in the main text is measured with the pseudo-oracles of Section D.1 .
While pseudo-oracles are widely adopted as a measure of effectiveness, we acknowledge the potential for evaluator bias to confound conclusions.
To investigate its impact on our results, we additionally re-scored every counterfactual with six independently trained public evaluators spanning different backbones, training paradigms and resolutions: four TorchXRayVision models [ 10 ] , CheXzero [ 65 ] , and a linear classifier fitted on frozen RAD-DINO features [ 45 ] .
Each evaluator is thresholded at its own Youden-optimal operating point on the NIH-14 train split rather than at 0.5 0.5 , so that flip rates are not confounded by differences in classifier calibration.
The evaluators themselves differ substantially in quality, spanning effusion AUC 0.756 0.756 to 0.864 0.864 , allowing us to compare oracle-based effectiveness across performances. Table 6 reports the resulting thresholds and discriminative performance.
blocks.zh:
主文中的有效性用D.1节的伪先知来衡量.
虽然伪甲骨文被广泛用作衡量效力的尺度,但我们承认评估者偏见有可能混淆结论。
为了调查其对结果的影响,我们再次对每个反事实进行计分,有6名受过独立培训的公共评价员,他们跨越不同的骨干、培训范式和决议:四个火炬X射线视觉模型[10]、CheXzero[65]和一个安装在冷冻的RAD-DINO特性上的线性分类器[45]。
每位评审员在NIH-14列车的自身Youden-opperature运行点拆分而非0.5 0.5 的临界值,因此翻转率不会因分类器校准的不同而困惑.
评价人员本身在质量上差异很大,包括喷洒量AUC 0.756 0.756 至 0.864 0.864 ,使我们能够比较基于甲骨文的绩效。 表6报告了由此产生的阈值和歧视性业绩。

blocks.en:
Importantly, the relative ordering of methods is stable across evaluators, with Kendall’s τ = 0.949 ± 0.048 \tau=0.949\pm 0.048 (all p < 0.003 p<0.003 ), as in Table 7 .
Every evaluator recovers the same ranking, while our proposed method remains consistently at the top.
It should be noted that HVAE were trained with an additional counterfactual finetuning step, which use effectiveness as a guiding signal for optimization.
Without the additional counterfactual finetuning, HVAE’s effectiveness drops significantly.
Absolute effectiveness, by contrast, varies widely on identical images: RadCF flips effusion for between 32.0 % 32.0\% and 47.2 % 47.2\% of cases depending only on which evaluator is asked, a 15 15 -point spread that broadly tracks evaluator AUC.
The comparative conclusions drawn from the main tables are therefore robust to the choice of evaluator, whereas any single absolute effectiveness number should be read as evaluator-relative.
We note one limitation: six evaluators are available only for effusion, and view, sex and age are re-scored with the RAD-DINO probe alone, so rank stability is established for effusion and assumed rather than verified for the remaining attributes.

blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2018-03-09). D.4 KID.

blocks.en:
Diverging from Melistas et al. [34] , we use the target-domain training set rather than test-split factuals as the reference distribution for KID.
This ensures realism reflects proximity to the data manifold independently of the evaluation population.

Shortcut learning audit experiment. At each bias level, we train a DenseNet-121 classifier to predict effusion with five-fold patient-level cross validation, reporting all results as the mean and standard deviation across folds.

We then compare the classifier’s predictions across the original, counterfactual, and control images.

快捷学习审计实验. 在每个偏差级别上,我们都会训练一台DenseNet-121分类器,以五倍的患者水平交叉验证来预测排液,报告所有结果为跨折叠的平均值和标准偏差.

blocks.en:
Counterfactual augmentation experiment. To test whether counterfactual augmentation can reduce shortcut learning during training, we compare a baseline classifier against three augmentation strategies: random upsampling, conventional random augmentation, and counterfactual augmentation.
Each strategy is size-matched to twice the biased set for a fair comparison.
Augmentation and auditing deliberately use different RadCF generation mechanisms: the view-flipped counterfactuals added to training come from s-spec trained on NIH-14, while the auditing is carried out by the independent sa-spec auditor.
This avoids circularity: were the same generator used for both, a classifier could appear robust simply by learning to agree with that generator’s edits.
Auditing with an independent generator ensures that reduced reliance reflects robustness to the view shortcut rather than consistency with the augmentation generator.

blocks.en: Appendix I Discussion on the break of Markovian assumption
blocks.zh: 关于马尔科维安假设中断的讨论

blocks.en:
The mechanism in Equation 1 assumes 𝐮 ⟂ 𝐩𝐚 \mathbf{u}\perp\mathbf{pa} , a standard assumption in deep structural causal modelling [ 41 , 40 , 35 , 13 , 54 , 56 ] .
Two questions it raises are worth separating: whether our estimator induces a violation, and whether the data satisfy the assumption in the first place.
blocks.zh:
方程式1中的机制假设u ⟂ pa \ mathbf{ u}\ perp\ mathbf{ pa},这是深层结构因果建模中的一项标准假设[41, 40, 35, 13, 54, 56].
它提出的两个问题是值得分开的:我们的估计者是否诱发违反,以及数据是否首先满足了假设.

blocks.en:
The model does not induce a violation. A batch-wise optimal-transport coupling [ 66 ] , for instance, pairs noise with data within each minibatch and thereby ties the inferred terminal noise to the sampled batch, which can reintroduce dependence between the abducted noise and the parents.
RadCF interpolates from a parent-independent Gaussian prior under an independent coupling: in Equation 2 the terminal noise is drawn as 𝐳 1 ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 𝐈 ) \mathbf{z}_{1}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,\mathbf{I}) independently of both the data encoding 𝐳 0 \mathbf{z}_{0} and the conditioning 𝐜 = 𝐩𝐚 \mathbf{c}=\mathbf{pa} , so prior and training coupling are parent-independent by construction.
blocks.zh:
该型号不会引发侵权. 例如,分批进行的最佳运输耦合[66],将噪声与每个小批量中的数据配对,从而将推断的终端噪声与抽样批量联系起来,这可以重新引起被绑架噪声与父母之间的依赖。
弧度 CF在独立耦合下先从父独立的高斯琴中插出:在方程式2中,终端噪声被绘制为z 1 → N →(0,I)\mathbf{z1}}\mathm\mathcal{N}(0,\mathbf{I}),独立于数据编码z 0\mathbf{z\0}和条件c=pa\mathbf{c}=\mathbf{pa},所以前与训练耦合通过构建是父母独立的.

blocks.en:
We cannot rule out confounding in the data. Causal sufficiency is not testable from i.i.d. images and labels [ 38 ] .
It underpins essentially all deep-SCM counterfactual image generation [ 40 , 35 , 13 , 54 , 56 ] , and as in that literature we target counterfactuals relative to the specified mechanism rather than uniquely identified real-world counterfactuals.
Under unobserved confounding RadCF remains a counterfactual estimator with respect to the fitted mechanism, but is not guaranteed to recover the true clinical counterfactual.
blocks.zh:
我们不能排除数据中的混乱。 i.d. 图像和标签[38] 无法检验因果关系的充分性。
它基本上支持所有深层SCM反事实图像生成[40,35,13,54,56],正如文献中的那样,我们针对的是相对于特定机制的反事实,而不是唯一识别的真实世界反事实.
在无法观察的混淆下,RadCF仍然是对安装机制的反事实估计,但不能保证恢复真正的临床反事实。

blocks.en:
Measuring the residual dependence. To measure the extent to which the abducted noise 𝐮 \mathbf{u} retains parent information, we fit linear probes to predict each parent from 𝐮 \mathbf{u} and report held-out probe AUC ( Table 13 ).
Independence by construction during training does not guarantee independence of the abducted noise at inference time, so we measure it directly.
Here lower is better, and 0.5 0.5 would indicate no linearly decodable parent information.
blocks.zh:
测量剩余依赖。 为了测量被绑架的噪声u\ mathbf{u}保留母信息的程度,我们配有线性探测器来预测来自u\ mathbf{u}的每个母数据,并报告被搁置的探测器AUC(表13).
在训练期间通过建筑独立并不能保证在推断时间被绑架噪音的独立,所以我们直接测量.
下限较好,0.5表示没有线性可解码的父信息。

blocks.en:
The unconditional mechanism serves as a reference point: it has no parent conditioning, so parent-related variation has nowhere to go except 𝐮 \mathbf{u} , and its probe AUCs are correspondingly high.
Specialisation lowers the predictability of every parent relative to it, indicating that conditioning moves parent-related variation out of the exogenous latent.
We still acknowledge that the abducted latent is not perfectly independent of the parents, and that the Markovian assumption may be violated to some degree in practice.
Thus, we rely on the axiomatic criteria to measure the quality of the counterfactuals relative to the fitted mechanism.
blocks.zh:

专门化降低了每个家长相对于它的可预测性,表明条件使与家长相关的变化脱离了外部潜在。
我们仍然承认,被绑架的潜质并非完全独立于父母,实际上可能在一定程度上违反了马尔科维安的假设。
因此,我们依靠定理标准来衡量相对适用机制的反事实的质量。

blocks.en: Table 3 in the main text compares m-spec against Causal-Adapter [ 67 ] under a matched backbone: every row is built on RadEdit, so the rows differ only in how causal structure is injected. Table 16 additionally reports the authors’ original implementation, which uses Stable Diffusion 1.5 as its backbone.

blocks.en: The SD1.5 rows are not backbone-matched, so effectiveness differences confound the pretrained backbone with the adaptation method. SD1.5 Causal-Adapter attains higher effectiveness on do ⁡ ( v ) \operatorname{do}(v) , do ⁡ ( s ) \operatorname{do}(s) and do ⁡ ( a ) \operatorname{do}(a) , which we attribute mainly to its natural-image pretraining: the attributes it recovers best are global image properties rather than localised pathology. Its composition ( 0.113 0.113 ) and reversibility ( 0.197 0.197 mean across interventions) are nonetheless worse than m-spec ( 0.061 0.061 / 0.167 0.167 ), and its realism is markedly worse (KID 3.13 3.13 vs. 1.35 1.35 ). Under the matched RadEdit backbone, m-spec improves on Causal-Adapter for every target attribute and for composition, reversibility and realism; the two exceptions are non-target preservation of sex under do ⁡ ( v ) \operatorname{do}(v) ( 0.947 0.947 vs. 0.963 0.963 ) and under do ⁡ ( a ) \operatorname{do}(a) ( 0.962 0.962 vs. 0.976 0.976 ).
